tasks.title: Implement the pure schema rules module

acceptance_criteria.text: `src/rules.mjs` exists and exports named functions `validateSchema` and `lint` (covers: REQ-20)
`test/rules.test.mjs` exists; `node --test test/rules.test.mjs` exits 0 run on its own (covers: REQ-22)
`src/rules.mjs` contains no import of `./parse.mjs` or any non-`node:` module (covers: REQ-22)
`validateSchema` accepts `{KEY: {required?, type?, enum?}}` objects and returns `[]` for a valid one (covers: REQ-1)
`validateSchema` returns ≥1 defect, without throwing, for `null`, `[]`, `"x"`, `{A: 1}`, `{A: {type: "float"}}`, `{A: {required: "yes"}}`, `{A: {enum: []}}` (covers: REQ-7)
A `required: true` key absent from pairs yields one finding `{key, line: null, rule: "required", message}` (covers: REQ-17)
`type: int` accepts `12`, `-3` and flags `1.5`, `x`; `type: bool` accepts `true`, `false` and flags `yes`, `TRUE`; `type: string` accepts anything (covers: REQ-18)
`type: url` accepts `https://a.b` and `http://a.b` and flags `foo:bar`, `ftp://x`, `not a url`, with no network access (covers: REQ-18)
`enum: ["a","b"]` flags value `c` with a finding at that value's line (covers: REQ-19)
Every finding names the key and its line (or `null` for `required`), so output can be key by key, line by line (covers: REQ-2)
For a duplicated key, only the last assignment is judged (covers: REQ-20)
`lint([], {A: {type: "int"}})` returns `[]` (optional key absent → no finding) (covers: REQ-6)
